full_judgment: 14. It appears that from the prosecution case that seized goods were recovered from in front of a shop owned by Delower who has not been examined. It further appears that there were 5 others members under the leadership of informant in the raiding party but none of the member of the raiding party was examined. Non-examination of shop keeper namely Delower and members of the raiding party calls for a presumption under section 114(g) of the Evidence Act adverse to the prosecution case that had they been examined they might have deposed against the prosecution case. Non-production member of the raiding party who were with P.W.1 and also the shop keeper of the place of occurrence caused serious doubt of the prosecution case giving rise to an adverse presumption under section 114(g) of the Evidence Act.
